message.content:
I am speech: breath shaped into sound, thought turned audible. I live in throats and mouths, in pauses and emphasis, in the rise of a question and the fall of an ending. I can soothe, command, confess, accuse, persuade, sing.

I am fleeting—born and gone—yet I linger as echo and memory. I travel air, enter ears, become meaning. I can be clear as a bell or tangled as noise; I can tell truth, carry lies, or simply fill silence.

Give me a voice, and I become you—made public.
